title: Document Knowledge projection scale and freshness boundaries
outOfScope: Changing projection, query, lifecycle, installer, Makefile, schema, or test behavior.
Changing the deterministic exact-AND Knowledge query contract or adding semantic, vector, RAG, or LLM ranking behavior.
Rewriting any previously archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, archive manifest, archive index, or Knowledge record.
Publishing a release, changing semantic versions or tags, or mutating provider release state.
Translating maintainer-only reference pages outside the three scoped user-facing siblings.

Current Finish lifecycle passes changed source-bound paths into Knowledge refresh.
Current Archive lifecycle includes the newly archived Work Item in its Knowledge projection.
Authoritative checker for records, query index, dependency index, and fail-closed consistency.
Canonical user-facing Knowledge guide whose current rewrite dropped the dependency and scale boundary.
Supporting design record describing affected-set routing, explicit recovery fallback, and historical scale risk.

rawUserRequest: 在已合并的三语用户文档中补齐 Knowledge Projection 的规模、刷新和恢复边界；保持本轮只改文档，不改变运行时，不发布新版本。用户已授权本 WI 按完整流程执行，包括提交、推送、PR、合并、关闭、分支清理和默认分支同步。

riskAssessment.reason: The change is documentation-only, but omitting the incremental path or overstating constant cost could mislead users about Knowledge freshness and lifecycle behavior across three languages.

reasons: The Work Item changes user-facing documentation and generated documentation evidence without changing runtime behavior.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized the complete lifecycle for this scoped documentation correction; runtime changes and release publication remain excluded.

declaredIntent.summary: Make the existing incremental Knowledge projection and its explicit recovery cost understandable to ordinary users in English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese without claiming a runtime change.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A user asks what happens when a new Work Item creates or refreshes Knowledge.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The guide explains that the current Work Item and affected records are refreshed through the dependency projection, while unrelated records are not normally rebuilt or rewritten.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Cross-check the wording against the current generator, Finish, Archive, and incremental projection design record.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The dependency projection is missing, malformed, stale, or incomplete.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The user is told that AI Cockpit explicitly rebuilds/revalidates or fails closed; it never silently trusts an old record, and full recovery cost may grow with history.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Cross-check the guide against the generator fallback, authoritative Knowledge checker, and archived design acceptance.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A reader switches among the English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese Knowledge and capability pages.
scenarioCoverage.expected: All three languages preserve the same incremental behavior, fallback, scale-cost limitation, stop condition, and non-RAG boundary.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run documentation metadata, capability, journey, Japanese, and semantic-parity checks, then review the three sibling sections together.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese Implementation Knowledge guides explain the dependency projection, normal affected-record refresh, explicit full-rebuild/fail-closed fallback, and why recovery cost can grow with historical Knowledge volume.

The three capability overview rows expose the same Knowledge projection boundary and link to the detailed localized guide without changing capability status or implying a runtime performance guarantee.

The wording remains natural-language-first for ordinary users, with commands and technical details progressive-disclosed; it clearly says this Work Item documents current behavior and does not implement a new optimization.
The final diff contains only the declared documentation and generated documentation evidence, with no production code, tests, installer, version, release, or tag mutation.

All required AI Cockpit, documentation, and traceability checks pass; the full project quality suite is retained as an optional diagnostic for this documentation-only, non-release Work Item, and the Work Item receives a merged PR and successful ai-close-work-item.
guidelines: Use natural-language, goal-oriented explanations before commands or file paths.
Keep English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese siblings semantically aligned for purpose, steps, result, stop conditions, and limitations.
Do not claim a runtime optimization, constant cost, semantic search, or RAG behavior that the current evidence does not support.
Keep Contract, Summary, Outcome, and repository Evidence as the authoritative sources; Knowledge remains a projection.

intent.problem: The user-facing Knowledge rewrite explains evidence and exact querying but no longer exposes the implemented dependency-aware refresh path or the cost boundary of explicit full recovery. A reader could therefore mistake a read-only query surface for a guarantee that all lifecycle maintenance has constant cost as historical Knowledge grows.
constraints: Document current behavior only: incremental affected-record routing is implemented; this Work Item must not change runtime behavior.
Preserve the evidence boundary: Contract, Summary, Outcome, and repository Evidence remain authoritative, while Knowledge remains a generated projection.
Preserve exact deterministic query, non-semantic/non-RAG, fail-closed, and fresh-adopter boundaries.
Keep all three localized siblings aligned and keep release/version paths untouched.
intent.rationale: A concise user-facing cost and recovery boundary is necessary HCI: it lets a reader understand what normally happens, why a recovery may be heavier, and when to stop or investigate without inventing an optimization or hiding a known trade-off.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user authorized automatic completion of this documentation-only Work Item through commit, push, PR, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch cleanup, and default-base synchronization; no release or version publication is authorized.

rollbackNote: Revert the declared documentation and generated documentation evidence; do not alter previously archived evidence or runtime behavior.
